main_body: A flat grass ground patch (4x3 tiles) with tufts and blades in several greens, tiling seamlessly; no standing object.
top_band: none - flat terrain texture; no top/front structure applies
evidence: Ground tile, not a standing object. It is a flat grass surface with no volume, so the 3/4 top/front contract does not apply and no side faces or elevation drawings are present. Terrain kind matches.

style.evidence: The grass patch uses about 5 green steps (dark, mid base, mid-light, light, bright highlight) in clustered blade tufts, with a repeating pattern that gives it dense variation. It has no outlines and no large flat areas; the mid-green base is broken up by tufts and dark specks. Compared with the Beodeul grass reference, which is flatter with sparse tufts, it is equally or more detailed per tile. The orange markers are alignment marks in the preview, not part of the art. The repetition is visible in the tile layout, but it is acceptable for a ground patch.
